47533-the-forest-farm-tales-of-the-austr.title: _Tales of the Austrian Tyrol_
47533-the-forest-farm-tales-of-the-austr.creator: Peter Rosegger
47533-the-forest-farm-tales-of-the-austr.description: A book by Peter Rosegger. The unmistakable trend of our time is the civilisation--which, in its modern form, is largely urbanisation--of the whole habitable globe. From its centres outwards it is thrusting itself upon places, men, processes--ultimate sanctuaries, never before reached by alien trespassing.

arxiv-2201-10460.creator: Thuan Nguyen, Boyang Lyu, Prakash Ishwar, Matthias Scheutz, Shuchin Aeron

arxiv-2205-08717.title: A Regression Approach to Learning-Augmented Online Algorithms
arxiv-2205-08717.creator: Keerti Anand, Rong Ge, Amit Kumar, Debmalya Panigrahi
arxiv-2205-08717.description: Abstract The emerging field of learning-augmented online algorithms uses ML techniques to predict future input parameters and thereby improve the performance of online algorithms. Since these parameters are, in general, real-valued functions, a natural approach is to use regression techniques to make these predictions.

arxiv-2303-18030.title: Exact solutions for submerged von Kármán point vortex streets cotravelling with a wave on a linear shear current
arxiv-2303-18030.creator: Jack S. Keeler, Darren G. Crowdy
arxiv-2303-18030.description: Abstract New exact solutions are presented to the problem of steadily-travelling water waves with vorticity wherein a submerged von Kármán point vortex street cotravels with a wave on a linear shear current. Surface tension and gravity are ignored. The work generalizes an earlier study by Crowdy & Nelson [Phys.

arxiv-2308-02764.title: Dataopsy: Scalable and Fluid Visual Exploration using Aggregate Query Sculpting
arxiv-2308-02764.creator: \authororcid Md Naimul Hoque0000-0003-0878-501X and \authororcid Niklas Elmqvist0000-0001-5805-5301
arxiv-2308-02764.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by \authororcid Md Naimul Hoque0000-0003-0878-501X and \authororcid Niklas Elmqvist0000-0001-5805-5301. We present aggregate query sculpting (AQS), a faceted visual query technique for large-scale multidimensional data. As a “born scalable” query technique, AQS starts visualization with a single visual mark representing an aggregation of the entire dataset.

arxiv-2406-07159.title: Eigenstate plateau transition and equilibration in one-dimensional quantum lattice models
arxiv-2406-07159.creator: Wei-Han Li, Abbas Ali Saberi
arxiv-2406-07159.description: Abstract We report a remarkable spectral phenomenon in a generic quantum lattice gas model. As the interaction strength increases, eigenstates spontaneously reorganize, leading to plateaus in the interaction energy. Gaps between plateaus can emerge similarly to continuous phase transitions. Our perturbation analysis indicates that, aside from these gaps, the plateau structure of the spectrum remains stable in the thermodynamic limit.

arxiv-2406-18458.title: Scalable tomography of many-body quantum environments with low temporal entanglement
arxiv-2406-18458.creator: Ilia A. Luchnikov, Michael Sonnner, Dmitry A. Abanin
arxiv-2406-18458.description: Abstract Describing dynamics of a quantum system coupled to a complex many-body environment is a ubiquitous problem in quantum science. General non-Markovian environments are characterized by their influence matrix (IM) – a multi-time tensor arising from repeated interactions between the system and environment.

arxiv-2411-18843.title: Laser-Controlled Nonlinear Hall Effect in Tellurium Solids via Nonlinear Phononics
arxiv-2411-18843.creator: Hongyu Chen, Xi Wu, Jiali Yang, Peizhe Tang, Jia Li
arxiv-2411-18843.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Hongyu Chen, Xi Wu, Jiali Yang, Peizhe Tang, Jia Li. A Terahertz (THz) laser with strong strength could excite more than one phonons and induce a transient lattice distortion termed as nonlinear phononics. This process allows dynamic control of various physical properties, including topological properties. Here, using first-principles calculations and dynamical simulations, we demonstrate that THz laser excitation can modulate the electronic structure and the signal of nonlinear Hall effect in elemental solid tellurium (Te).

arxiv-2504-21246.title: Activation entropy helps explain anomalous flow stress temperature dependence in copper
arxiv-2504-21246.creator: Mohammadhossein Nahavandian, Liam Myhill, Enrique Martinez
arxiv-2504-21246.description: Abstract Thermal activation of dislocations is critical for predicting the mechanical response of materials under common experimental conditions. According to transition state theory (TST), the rate for the system to overcome free energy barriers depends on an attempt frequency, activation free energy, and temperature.

arxiv-2505-17035.title: New estimates of the spin and accretion rate of the black hole M87 ∗ Facilities: EHT; JCMT
arxiv-2505-17035.creator: Michael Drew, Joshua S. Stanway, Brett A. Patterson, Timothy J. Walton, Derek Ward-Thompson
arxiv-2505-17035.description: Abstract In this paper we use the imaging results of M87* from the EHT to calculate the rotational velocity of the inner edge of the accretion disk and find a value of ∼ \sim 0.14c. We then calculate the dimensionless spin parameter, a a , of the black hole, obtaining a value of a ∼ 0.8 a\sim 0.8 .

arxiv-2507-09377.title: A Fixed Parameter Tractable Approach for Solving the Vertex Cover Problem in Polynomial Time Complexity
arxiv-2507-09377.creator: Mumuksh Tayal
arxiv-2507-09377.description: Abstract The Minimum Vertex Cover problem, a classical NP-complete problem, presents significant challenges for exact solution on large graphs. Fixed-Parameter Tractability (FPT) offers a powerful paradigm to address such problems by exploiting a parameter of the input, typically related to the size of the desired solution.

arxiv-2508-13733.title: Statistical-Mechanical Theory on the Probability Distribution Function for the Net Charge of an Electrolyte Droplet
arxiv-2508-13733.description: Abstract Droplets of electrolyte solutions in an insulating medium are ubiquitous in nature. The net charges of these droplets are normally nonzero, and they fluctuate. However, a theory on the probability distribution function for the net charge of droplets is lacking, so far.

arxiv-2509-20060.title: Discrete Diffusion for Generative Modeling of Text-Aligned Speech Tokens
arxiv-2509-20060.creator: Pin-Jui Ku, He Huang, Jean-Marie Lemercier, Subham Sekhar Sahoo, Zhehuai Chen, Ante Jukić
arxiv-2509-20060.description: Abstract This paper introduces a discrete diffusion model (DDM) framework for text-aligned speech tokenization and reconstruction. By replacing the auto-regressive speech decoder with a discrete diffusion counterpart, our model achieves significantly better reconstruction quality, stronger ASR performance, and faster inference.

arxiv-2601-16246.title: Recovering Einstein’s Mature View of Gravitation: A Dynamical Reconstruction Grounded in the Equivalence Principle
arxiv-2601-16246.creator: Jaume de Haro, Emilio Elizalde
arxiv-2601-16246.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Jaume de Haro, Emilio Elizalde. The historical and conceptual foundations of General Relativity are revisited, putting the main focus on the physical meaning of the invariant d ​ s 2 ds^{2} , the Equivalence Principle, and the precise interpretation of spacetime geometry. It is argued that Albert Einstein initially sought a dynamical formulation in which d ​ s 2 ds^{2} encoded the gravitational effects, without invoking curvature as a physical entity.

pmc-10607955.title: Cardiac Magnetic Resonance in Patients with Suspected Tachycardia-Induced Cardiomyopathy: The Impact of Late Gadolinium Enhancement and Epicardial Fat Tissue
pmc-10607955.creator: Oleg Orlov, Aref Asfour, Dmitry Shchekochikhin, Zainab Magomedova, Alexandra Bogdanova, Anna Komarova, Maxim Podianov, Grigory Gromyko, Ekaterina Pershina, Alexey Nesterov, Alexandra Shilova, Natalya Ionina, Dennis Andreev
pmc-10607955.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Tachycardia-induced cardiomyopathy (TIC) is a reversible subtype of dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM) resulting from sustained supraventricular or ventricular tachycardia and diagnosed by the normalization of left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) after stable sinus rhythm restoration. The aim of this study was to determine the contribution of cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) to the differential diagnosis of TIC and DCM with persistent atrial arrythmias in patients hospitalized for the first time with heart failure (HF) with reduced LVEF of nonischemic origin.

pmc-10618560.title: A systematic review and meta-analysis of food handling practices in Ghana vis-a-vis the associated factors among food handlers during 2009 and 2022
pmc-10618560.creator: Lawrence Sena Tuglo, Snehasish Mishra, Ranjan K Mohapatra, Nii Korley Kortei, John Nsor-Atindana, Henok Mulugeta, Qingyun Lu, Mavis Pearl Kwabla, Agabus Tetteh Patu, Tania Chaudhuri, Jessica Dzigbordi Tuglo, Subrata Narayan Das, Sylvia Mawusinu Sakre, Komla Sylvester Affram, Alfred Doku
pmc-10618560.description: Foodborne diseases (FBDs) are a major public health concern, especially in Sub-Saharan African (SSA) countries, such as Ghana, where poor food handling practices (FHPs) are prevalent. To estimate the pooled proportion of good FHPs and the associated factors among Ghanaian food handlers, this systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted to aid scholars, practitioners and policymakers in devising FBD-preventable interventions.

pmc-12946173.title: Fast multi-resolution 3D printing of microfluidics: enabling 2 μm channels and ultra-compact mixers
pmc-12946173.creator: Dallin S Miner, Matthew S Viglione, Kent Hooper, Adam T Woolley, Gregory P Nordin
pmc-12946173.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Microfluidic devices with ultra-fine features are critical for applications in biomedical diagnostics, chemical analysis, and lab-on-chip systems, but achieving high-resolution negative features with fast print times remains a significant challenge due to limitations in conventional 3D printing techniques. Motivated by the need for rapid fabrication of precise, compact microfluidic structures to enhance performance and miniaturization, we present an efficient multi-resolution 3D printing technique designed to fabricate microfluidic devices with exceptionally high-resolution negative features.

pmc-12993412.title: Preoperative inflammatory profile in chronic coronary syndrome reveals interleukin-2 as a promising biomarker for postoperative atrial fibrillation risk stratification
pmc-12993412.creator: Dan-Alexandru Cozac, Cristina Somkereki, Tunde Renata Nicoara, Adina Huțanu, Liliana Demian, Irina Cabac-Pogorevici, Alina Scridon

It is associated with increased morbidity, mortality, hemodynamic instability, thromboembolic events, longer hospital stays, and higher healthcare costs [1], [2], [3].

pmc-13201345.title: How Have Researchers Estimated the Impact of Excess Weight on Mortality? A Systematic Review
pmc-13201345.creator: Guadalupe García, Cristina Candal-Pedreira, Julia Rey-Brandariz, Lucía de Luis Cid, Mónica Pérez-Ríos
pmc-13201345.description: ObjectiveThe aim of this review is to describe and reflect on the methodology of the studies that estimate the attributable mortality (AM) to excess weight. The purpose was to provide a methodological framework and serve as a starting point to improve the estimation of AM to excess weight. This will lead to more comparable estimates over time and across countries.

pmc-13301122.description: Background/Objective: Postpartum hemorrhage is a leading cause of maternal morbidity and mortality, particularly among high-risk women undergoing cesarean section. This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluated the efficacy and safety of prophylactic tranexamic acid in high-risk cesarean sections. Methods: A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials was conducted. Risk of bias was assessed using RoB 2.
